restaurant_name: Prime Clinic ไพร์ม คลินิกเวชกรรม
text:
The service was terrible, according to the salesperson, Arm, who claimed to have a lot of sales experience.

I used their laser hair removal service + premium face mask.

After the laser treatment, the staff member, Nune, informed me that the room was unavailable and asked if I could come back in the evening. However, I arrived at 10:30 AM, the first customer, and tried to explain my unavailability.

The manager, Kwang, and Nune tried to find a room for me and apologized.

Arm made very unpleasant remarks:

"You already got a room, it only took 30 minutes," and then implied that customers usually inform them immediately.

But I had already informed them via their Facebook page that I wanted the treatments done at the same time, specifically mentioning "I won't be wearing makeup." The admin responded with "Okay, customer."

I understand that the admin has many messages and many customers, so mistakes can happen, but their response was unprofessional. They spoke with their legs crossed, showing complete lack of professionalism.

A very perfunctory apology was called today:

"I apologize for what I did wrong, Jenny."

I then asked:

1. What do you need, Jenny?
2. Where do you work, Jenny?

3. I already apologized to you, Jenny.

4. I have many customers.

They just wanted to hang up. They didn't listen to us at all, constantly interrupting. When we tried to explain why we were dissatisfied, they claimed there were many customers and they needed to attend to others first. We even suggested we talk later when they were free.

The apology was very superficial, like "Sorry," not really.

Please have management review this salesperson.
Thank you.
